title: Launch Guardrails: Runway and Release Ops for API v2
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinated launch risk management for API v2: establish pre-launch blockers checklist, define guarded rollout lanes, codify rollback procedures, and provide ready-to-send incident communication templates for on-call, PM, and comms. Deliverable is a single-runbook and a release notes package the GTM team can use.
scope: Covers hosted Redwood API v2 public launch. Includes release blockers and sign-off criteria, rollback and failover steps for primary model endpoints, incident comms templates for Severity 1/2 scenarios, and a release notes coordination checklist for docs, SDKs, and customer success.
objectives: Eliminate unknown blockers by gating launch on explicit sign-offs
Provide clear rollback steps with estimated RTO/RPO for each critical flow
Create templated comms for fast, consistent messages to customers and internal teams
Coordinate release notes and SDK compatibility messaging across engineering, DX, and CS
rollout_matrix: Canary (10% traffic, 2h min) -> Gradual increase (10% increments every 2h with health gates) -> Full. Health gates: 95th latency, error-rate, token-cost variance. Hold/backout criteria defined per metric.
rollback_plan: Step 1: Pause new deployments and divert new requests to previous model variant (api-v1-stable).
Step 2: Revert routing in traffic router (service: ingress-router) using saved traffic policy (tag: pre-launch-stable).
Step 3: Scale up v1 workers by +20% capacity within Dedicated pool if sustained load requires it.
Step 4: Notify on-call, PM, and CSE using incident templates; open Slack #inc-ops and #gtt-launch channels.
Step 5: Run health validation checklist (end-to-end smoke tests, key customer flows, latency profile).
Step 6: If rollback fails, escalate to SRE Director and prepare emergency mitigation (circuit-breaker adjustments).
incident_comm_templates: SEV1_INITIAL: Subject: [SEV1][API v2] Partial outage affecting inference; Body: Short summary of impact (who/what/when), immediate mitigation in progress (traffic diversion to api-v1), estimated time to next update (30m), owner (on-call name), link to runbook and dashboard.

SEV1_UPDATE: Subject: [SEV1][API v2] Update - Mitigation in progress; Body: What changed since last update, observed metrics (error rate, lat p95), actions taken, ETA for next update or resolution, next steps and owner.

SEV1_RESOLUTION: Subject: [SEV1][API v2] Resolved - Root cause analysis in progress; Body: Summary of resolution, customer-facing impact statement, timeline of events, link to postmortem placeholder and next steps for follow-up.
SEV2_TEMPLATE: Subject: [SEV2][API v2] Degradation impacting subset of customers; Body: Describe affected features and workarounds, expected remediation plan and owner, link to status page entry.

POSTMORTEM_TEMPLATE: Subject: Postmortem - API v2 outage (YYYY-MM-DD); Body: Summary, impact, timeline, root cause, action items, owners, release-blocker implications, and customer communications taken.
release_notes_coordination: Create a single release-notes draft in Docs with sections: Highlights, Breaking Changes, Migration guide, SDK changes, Known issues.
Engineering to confirm backward-compatibility matrix and list of deprecated endpoints (ENG-3912).
DX to produce code snippets for SDKs (Python, JS) and verify sample apps compile against staged SDK release (ENG-4015).
CS to prepare customer-facing FAQ and an account-targeted email for admins listing preflight checks.
Comms to prepare blog + changelog hero, coordinate publish window with downtime/rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: All pre-launch blockers either resolved or explicitly waived with PM + Eng sign-off
Rollback plan validated in staging with a dry-run and checklist completion
Incident templates tested by on-call in a tabletop exercise
Release notes draft reviewed by engineering, DX, CS, and legal and marked ready-to-publish
risks_mitigations: Risk: Latency regression at high token lengths -> Mitigation: Hold rollout, revert to cached KV path and run lightweight perf patch; measurement dashboard with alerts.
Risk: SDK incompatibility -> Mitigation: Publish pre-release SDK and run upgrade smoke with top 20 customers via CSEs.
Risk: Unexpected cost spike for long-running batches -> Mitigation: Enable cost cap per-request and autoscale limits; temporary throttles ready.
Risk: Insufficient on-call capacity during launch peak -> Mitigation: Schedule additional rotation and have SRE escalation on standby.
